title: Bundler calls can be identified by MEV bots and front-run

title: Operation with zero joinsplits can be tampered with
quote: if an operation has zero joinsplits, no joinsplit circuits are verified, and so a bundler can freely change the calls executed.

consumer_effect: External calls (actions) executed by Handler
unbound_value: Operation digest / actions list when no joinsplit proof present

notes: Borderline: no proof is verified at all, so criterion 1 (proof verified) arguably unmet; low impact per auditor. Fix 50fe52a9 resolved via API to 50fe52a993c932b71313ad336c3303c664e26c60.
